name: Senoo Yukihisa
source: He used to be an avid baseball player but due to an elbow injury he had to stop. He accepted his situation and decided to be positive and find something else to enjoy, however he sometimes still longs to play baseball.
translation: He used to be an avid baseball player but due to an elbow injury he had to stop. He accepted his situation and decided to be positive and find something else to enjoy, however he sometimes still longs to play baseball.
